summary: The UPU August 2026 General Addressing Issues publication places Antigua and Barbuda in its September 2025 list of countries which do not require postal codes. Current UPU entity and MDSA references identify Antigua and Barbuda Postal Service, General Post Office and organization code AGA, but provide no complete public identifier/alias/exception/non-area denominator and no postal area geometry. The public references are copyright restricted or do not grant resource-specific AGID processing, derivation, redistribution and public-serving rights. M2 remains blocked; the existing draft Postal Forge pack is synthetic planning evidence and was not promoted.

postalEvidence.governmentEntity: Ministry of Finance and Corporate Governance

reproducibility.pdfInspection: pdfplumber exact page-count and page-marker validation against byte/SHA-256-bound official PDFs
reproducibility.geometryTransformation: none; no source row, coordinate or geometry was copied, transformed or promoted into Git
reproducibility.visualizationDecision: No report chart was added because this is a single-country authority and rights audit with zero eligible postal geometry; exact tabular metrics and prose communicate the result more clearly.

limitations: The UPU no-required-postcode classification establishes optionality, not an exhaustive absence of internal office, route, P.O.-box or organization identifiers.
No current complete operator-authorized public identifier, alias, eligibility, exception and explicit non-area denominator was found.
No official, derived or virtual postal Polygon/MultiPolygon and no code-to-area relationship was found.
UPU copyright and public access to official references do not establish compatible AGID processing, derivation, redistribution or public-serving rights.
No browser E2E was run because there is no eligible real AG postal area artifact to render.
